findings.evidence: `rg -n "ofArrow" TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Quiver/PathAlgebra.lean` finds only the definition at line 665 and uses inside `adjoin_vertexIdempotents_union_arrows`; unlike `ofPath` and `vertexIdempotent`, it has no exported `*_eq_single`/`*_def` lemma.
findings.fix: Add a public characteristic lemma such as `@[simp] theorem ofArrow_eq_ofPath (e : a ⟶ b) : ofArrow e = ofPath ⟨a,b,e.toPath⟩ := (rfl)` (or an equivalent `single` restatement), so existing path-product and idempotent lemmas apply downstream.
findings.issue: `PathAlgebra.ofArrow` is an opaque public definition with no theorem relating it to `ofPath` or `single`; outside this module it is only usable as an uninterpreted element, including in the generation theorem.

summary: The new arrow constructor is opaque but has no public characterization, so downstream code cannot connect arrows to the path basis or compute their action.
